title: Nathan Fielder Addresses Unconventional Doc Techniques in ‘You Can See Everything’ as Academy Doc Branch Members Weigh In (Exclusive)
summary: "I'm really happy that your film is doing as well as it's doing because I think it pushes the boundaries and we all learn from it," Amir Bar-Lev told Fielder, while Chai Vasarhelyi said of the huge box office showing of the doc, "It was kind of like the most beautiful moment ever in nonfiction."
